abstract_sentences.text: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong problem-solving through long chain-of-thought, but their deployment is constrained by the high cost of full-precision inference and growing KV cache footprints.

evidence.anchor: “deployment is constrained by the high cost”

abstract_sentences.text: Microscaled FP4 formats enable efficient FP4 deployment; however, fully quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches (W4A4KV4) causes severe reasoning degradation that existing PTQ and QAT fail to recover.

We identify that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens—precise symbolic commitments such as digits and operators—where quantization noise inflates sampling errors that cascade through reasoning traces.

Based on this insight, we propose ReQAT, a reasoning-centric FP4 training framework with three components: (i) Trace-Aligned QAT (TAQ), which revisits identical reasoning traces to focus updates on critical low-entropy decisions; (ii) Selective Entropy Minimization (SEM), which reinforces confidence at low-entropy positions; and (iii) Q-FIT, a quantization-friendly initialization that jointly calibrates RoPE-consistent KV cache transformations to stabilize QAT.
Under the same training budget, ReQAT not only recovers but surpasses BF16 fine-tuning accuracy, while delivering up to 3.9× throughput speedup on NVIDIA DGX Spark and 3.1× on B200.

claim_closure.claim: FP4 failure 集中在低熵 symbolic commitments
claim_closure.method_response: TAQ/SEM 显式瞄准 low-entropy token predictions。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig. 2、Fig. 7、Fig. 8–9 提供 routing、tail mass、gradient 与 qualitative cascade。

claim_closure.claim: trace alignment 比增加 QAT budget 更关键
claim_closure.method_response: Stage-2 使用 D_TAQ ⊆ D_FT，重访同一 trace。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 4、Fig. 7、Table 9/13 支持 aligned 与 multi-epoch 对照，但仍是 aggregate/proxy。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 以 gradient reallocation 解释，§8 未单独回收。

claim_closure.claim: SEM 在低熵位置恢复 confidence
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (1) 与 soft w_t 在 τ 下选择性最小化 entropy。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 2、12、16 显示 AIME 更明显、mask/λ 有支持，但无 per-token uncertainty。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §8 将 SEM 纳入 ReQAT 总体方法，没有单独的理论 guarantee。

claim_closure.claim: Q-FIT 处理 RoPE/KV cache distortion
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (2)、α_s/α_m calibration 和 Algorithm 1 以 attention-output MSE 选变换。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig. 5、10–11、Table 5/17 支持 loss/accuracy 改善，未给 deployment-level cache error guarantee。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §8 只回收高层 accuracy/efficiency，不回收 Q-FIT 的独立效应。

evidence.anchor: “minimizing the distance between BF16 and KV4 attention outputs”

claim_closure.claim: 同 budget 下 ReQAT 达到/超越 BF16 或强 baseline
claim_closure.method_response: TAQ + Q-FIT + SEM，Stage-2 设为 70M 并在方法间匹配总 budget。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1–3、10：Qwen 常超过 BF16 FT，Llama 主要超过 PTQ/QAT；variant 与预算存在非单调性。

claim_closure.claim: 长 reasoning 与 code 仍受益
claim_closure.method_response: 将 response-length 分层与 LiveCodeBench 接入评测。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 6 的 24–32K 相对 PTQ 更强，Table 7 的 TQS 达 53.59/54.52。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §8 未逐项回收，但 §5 已给出直接结果。

claim_closure.method_response: Q-FIT scaling folded into weights，shift 在 inference 固定；TensorRT-LLM benchmark。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig. 6 给 speedup，Appendix D.3 说明 DGX Spark 是 W4A4KV8、B200 是 W4A4KV4；无真实 production workload。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把 FP4 reasoning degradation 重新定位为低熵 symbolic token 的 sampling risk，再用 TAQ 重访同一 trace、SEM 锐化低熵 confidence、Q-FIT 校准 RoPE/KV cache，形成同 budget 的 FP4 QAT 闭环。〔pp. 3–6，interpretation，“low-entropy token predictions”〕
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Fig. 2 的机制诊断、Fig. 3–5 的组件管线、Table 1–3 的 accuracy、Fig. 6 的吞吐、Table 4–5 的核心消融和 Fig. 7 的 gradient 回收。〔pp. 3–9，layout_observation，“Table 4”〕
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix B–D 放入完整协议、Eq. (3)、Q-FIT Algorithm 1、8-seed/四年 AIME aggregation、hyperparameters、FP8-KV caveat 与 Tables 8–17；复现和硬件主张依赖附录。〔pp. 15–22，interpretation，“FP8 KV cache”〕
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的是“受控 failure diagnosis → 组件映射 → 同预算累加表”：Fig. 2 将 entropy 机制拆成 routing/noise/tail mass，Fig. 3 接到 training stages，Table 1 对齐 component 与 budget。〔pp. 3、5、7，interpretation，“controlled intervention isolates”〕
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口是 aggregate point estimates 与强 summary wording 之间的统计边界，以及 TQ/TQS 非单调、logit-noise proxy/gradient ratio 到最终 accuracy 的识别差距；DGX Spark 的 KV8 例外也被延后。〔pp. 7–8、20–22，interpretation，“up to”〕
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对 quantization/system recovery 主张，先用受控 intervention 定位具体 state/token failure，再让每个组件只修复一个可观测 failure，并用同 budget 组件表、机制图和独立 deployment metric 共同验证。〔pp. 3–8，interpretation，“same training budget”〕
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则要求 entropy/state 可定义、supervision trace 可复用，且清楚区分 proxy 与 outcome；当 KV precision、hardware path、seed dispersion 或 domain 改变时，不能把单一 benchmark 或“up to speedup”外推成一般保证。〔pp. 15–22，interpretation，“proxy for relative logit distortions”〕
